review_candidates.title: Finance Officer
review_candidates.description: Job Description PORTEE DU ROLE : Assurer la gestion quotidienne des opérations financières, comptables et de trésorerie conformément aux politiques de Save the Children International (SCI), aux exigences des bailleurs de fonds et à la réglementation nationale. Il garantit la qualité des pièces comptables, le respect des procédures de contrôle interne et la disponibilité d'informations financières fiables. “Tout le personnel de Save the Children s'efforce de permettre à nos équipes programme opérations et plaidoyer des bureaux pays d'effectuer un travail de qualité supérieure, dans les délais impartis, selon le budget, avec conformité et dans le respect du plus grand nombre d'enfants.” Dimension Du Poste Supervisé par : Senior Finance officer Principaux Domaines De Responsabilite Gestion comptable Vérifier l'exhaustivité et la conformité des pièces justificatives. Préparer et enregistrer les transactions comptables dans le système financier. S'assurer de la bonne imputation budgétaire et analytique des dépenses. Maintenir un classement physique et électronique adéquat des documents financiers. Participer aux clôtures comptables mensuelles. Traitement des paiements Préparer les demandes de paiement conformément aux procédures SCI. Vérifier les autorisations requises avant décaissement. Assurer le traitement des paiements fournisseurs, consultants et prestataires. Assurer le suivi des avances de mission et avances de fonctionnement. Contrôler les pièces justificatives des liquidations. Gestion de la trésorerie Effectuer les paiements en caisse ou par banque selon les procédures en vigueur. Tenir à jour les livres de banque et de caisse. Participer aux contrôles de caisse périodiques. Préparer les rapprochements bancaires. Appuyer la préparation des prévisions de trésorerie. Contrôle interne et conformité Veiller au respect des politiques financières de SCI. Vérifier la conformité des transactions avec les procédures internes. Signaler toute anomalie ou risque de non-conformité. Participer aux contrôles internes et aux revues financières. Assurer une piste d'audit complète pour toutes les transactions. Suivi budgétaire Assister les gestionnaires de budget dans le suivi des dépenses. Produire les rapports de suivi budgétaire selon les besoins. Identifier les écarts budgétaires et les signaler à la hiérarchie. Contribuer à l'élaboration des prévisions financières. Reporting Préparer les rapports financiers internes requis. Fournir les données financières nécessaires aux analyses du Senior Finance Officer. Participer à la préparation des rapports destinés aux bailleurs. Assurer la qualité et l'exactitude des informations financières. Audit et Archivage Préparer les pièces justificatives pour les audits internes et externes. Assister dans la mise en œuvre des recommandations d'audit. Garantir un archivage conforme aux exigences SCI et bailleurs. Maintenir un système de documentation financière facilement accessible. Qualifications And Experiences Un niveau universitaire (Graduat minimum) dans le domaine financier (comptabilité, Economie…) est requis pour ce poste. Un très bon maniement des techniques informatiques [Excel /Logiciels comptables/ Word / Base de données est nécessaire. La connaissance de la langue anglaise est un atout. L’esprit d’équipe et une bonne capacité à communiquer, une bonne maitrise de soi sont requises pour ce poste. Etre disponible et motivé pour travailler avec Save the Children. Etre patient, dynamique, à l’écoute, positif, Etre professionnel Savoir gérer le stress et être capable de travailler dans des conditions difficiles. Capacités d’organisation, grande aptitude à travailler en équipe, empathie et flexibilité ; Avoir au minimum deux ans d’expérience dans le domaine humanitaire et surtout dans les programmes des Finances Accepter de travailler sous pression. Minimum 2 ans d’expérience à un poste similaire Maitrise du Contexte de la province du Nord Kivu Maitrise des Outils informatiques: Word Excel, Power Point… About Us Save the children India employ approximately 300 people across the globe and work on the ground in over 100 countries to help children affected by crises, or those that need better healthcare, education and child protection. We also campaign and advocate at the highest levels to realise the right of children and to ensure their voices are heard. We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030: No child dies from preventable causes before their 5th birthday All children learn from a quality basic education and that, Violence against children is no longer tolerated We know that great people make a great organization, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children. review_candidates.description: À propos du poste iBanFirst accélère sa croissance en Belgique et recherche des commerciaux expérimentés pour rejoindre notre équipe commerciale dynamique à Bruxelles et Anvers. Si vous êtes intéressé par la fintech, que vous souhaitez évoluer dans des environnements jeunes et que vous avez une solide expérience dans la gestion du cycle de vente complet, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer. Développer notre portefeuille client dans le domaine du change de devises en gérant l’intégralité du cycle de vente, de la prospection à l’intégration des clients. Assurer le suivi des processus de vente, en communicant régulièrement l’avancement avec les prospects et les décideurs clés. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques et de gestion de comptes pour garantir la performance optimale de nos solutions et la qualité du service. Établir et entretenir des relations durables avec des Directeurs Financiers, afin de comprendre leurs besoins en matière de change et de leur proposer des solutions personnalisées. Développer une expertise approfondie des produits FX d’iBanFirst et du secteur des services financiers pour offrir des conseils d’experts et élaborer des stratégies efficaces. Ce que nous recherchons : 1 à 2 ans d’expérience dans la gestion du cycle de vente complet. Expérience préalable en B2B dans le secteur des services financiers ou un intérêt de développer ses connaissances financières et économiques. Réalisations tangibles en matière de prospection, de conclusion de contrats et d’atteinte régulière des objectifs dans des cycles de vente. Excellentes compétences en communication, en négociation et en présentation. Capacité à analyser les besoins des clients et à résoudre des problèmes complexes, avec une aptitude à assimiler rapidement de nouvelles informations et à passer à l’action. Attitude proactive et entrepreneurial. Ce que nous offrons : Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à croissance rapide et une équipe dynamique au centre d'Anvers, avec des collègues motivés et l'objectif commun de devenir le pionnier en Europe. Un salaire conforme au marché; Une excellent structure de bonus non plafonné, basée sur votre propre performance; Assurance hospitalisation et assurance groupe; Une voiture de société avec carte essence; un remboursement de votre abonnement téléphone; Chèques-repas et éco-chèques; 20 jours légaux +12 jours de vacances supplémentaires (sur la base d'un emploi à templs plein) Rejoignez iBanFirst Belgique dès aujourd’hui et contribuez à façonner l’avenir des paiements internationaux ! Qui sommes-nous ? iBanFirst est une fintech européenne en pleine croissance qui révolutionne les paiements internationaux pour les PME. Fondée en 2016, notre plateforme permet aux SMM (Small & Medium Multinationals) de reprendre le contrôle de leurs opérations de paiements : conversion de devises (FX), transactions internationales et gestion du risque de change à travers 140 pays – de manière rapide, transparente et sécurisée . Nous simplifions la vie des PME grâce à une plateforme technologique avancée (automatisation, APIs, IA…) et une expertise dédiée , pour offrir le meilleur des deux mondes : l’agilité d’un SaaS et la confiance d’une relation personnalisée. iBanFirst aide ainsi des milliers d’entreprises audacieuses à profiter des opportunités de business mondiales avec sérénité, en leur apportant simplicité, transparence et sécurité. Quelques chiffres clés 350+ collaborateurs répartis dans 13 bureaux et 10 pays en Europe Plus de 30 nationalités différentes, moyenne d’âge 32 ans 10 000 entreprises clientes qui nous font confiance 65 M€ de revenus en 2024, avec un objectif de 85 M€ environ en 2025 Rentable depuis bientôt 2 ans Classée depuis 6 années consécutives dans le Financial Times FT1000, parmi les entreprises européennes à la plus forte croissance Un NPS de 87,5 un score exceptionnel dans l’industrie qui reflète les retours élogieux sur la simplicité, la rapidité et la qualité du service que nous offrons Une culture forte, structurée autour de nos 4 valeurs Team First : Parce que la complexité de notre secteur exige une forte intelligence collective, nous valorisons la coopération, la transparence et le partage de connaissances. Les succès sont collectifs, les décisions prises ensemble. Tenacity : Le marché que nous transformons ne se laisse pas facilement apprivoiser. Nous faisons preuve d’endurance, nous apprenons vite, et nous ne reculons pas devant les défis — cela fait partie de notre ADN entrepreneurial. Transformation : L’innovation n’est pas une posture, c’est une nécessité dans un secteur aussi stratégique et mouvant. Nous innovons avec exigence : chaque amélioration technique, produit ou organisationnelle vise un vrai impact. Trust : La confiance est le fondement de tout ce que nous construisons — avec nos clients comme en interne. Elle repose sur l’encouragement à la prise d’initiative, l’autonomie et une exigence de transparence, de rigueur et de fiabilité. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Nous opérons au cœur d’un secteur stratégique en pleine transformation: les paiements internationaux pour PME, un marché complexe au potentiel considérable. Une mission qui a du sens et dont nous sommes fiers: aider les “Small & Medium Multinationals” audacieuses à oser le business à l’international. Notre plateforme qui intègre des technologies avancées (IA, automatisation…) offre un cadre idéal pour tester, apprendre et innover en continu. Vous rejoindrez un environnement agile où votre expertise aura un impact concret, aux côtés de profils issus des meilleures institutions financières. Rentable, Ibanfirst s’appuie aussi sur des investisseurs de long terme : Xavier Niel et BPI France, investisseurs historiques, nous soutiennent et font confiance depuis le début En 2021, l’entrée du fonds américain Marlin Equity Partners a marqué une nouvelle étape de notre ambition internationale.

Mentor, develop, and support staff, fostering professional growth and team performance. Other duties as required. review_candidates.description: Business Intelligence | Reporting Suite Governance | Data Governance | Business Partnering & Data Storytelling Help us turn trusted data into better business decisions MSIG Specialty Marine NV is on a journey to become a more data-driven, insight-led and future-ready organisation. We are looking for a Data Product Owner – BI & Data Governance to help shape how data is owned, governed, understood and used across the business. This is not just a reporting role. It is a highly visible opportunity to move the organisation from dashboards and management information towards trusted decision intelligence where data products are clear, reliable, well adopted and directly linked to business outcomes. You will sit at the centre of business, data, technology, change and leadership, acting as the bridge between what the business needs, what the data can tell us, and how insight can drive better decisions. About MSIG Specialty Marine MSIG Specialty Marine NV is part of the Japanese MS&AD Insurance Group and operates in the global Marine & Specialty insurance market. We provide high-quality underwriting and claims services to clients worldwide across areas including Cargo, Fixed Premium P&I, Hull, Liability, Specie, War and Superyacht/Yacht Insurance. With approximately 220 employees across international offices in London, Rotterdam, Hamburg, Paris and Singapore, we combine the strength of a global group with the feel of a specialist, entrepreneurial business. We are flat, open and practical, with short lines of communication and real opportunities to take ownership, build capability and make an impact. Why this role matters Data is becoming one of MSIG Specialty Marine’s most important business capabilities. To make better, faster and more consistent decisions, we need trusted reporting, clear KPI definitions, strong governance, high-quality data products and business stakeholders who feel confident using insight. This Role Brings Together Four Critical Areas BI product ownership and roadmap management Reporting suite governance, quality and standardisation Practical data governance, ownership and stewardship, helping to establish clear roles and responsibilities for domain owners and data stewards and bringing greater ownership and accountability into the organisation Business partnering, data storytelling and insight adoption You will help ensure that data moves from being a reporting output to becoming a strategic business asset, with clear ownership, meaningful metrics and a strong narrative that helps stakeholders understand what the data is telling them, why it matters and what action should follow. What you will be doing You will own and continuously improve the roadmap for BI products, dashboards, reporting suites and insight solutions. Working closely with business leaders, analysts, engineering, innovation, IT architecture and third-party partners, you will translate business priorities into clear data products, user stories, requirements and delivery priorities. You will also take ownership of reporting governance, helping to standardise KPI definitions, data sources, business rules, reporting logic, quality controls and sign-off processes. A key part of the role will be reducing duplicated or manual reporting and promoting trusted reporting solutions as the primary source of truth. As a business partner, you will work with teams across Finance, Underwriting, Claims, Marine Pricing, Operations, HR, Change and Senior Management to understand what decisions need to be made, what metrics matter most, how success should be measured and which indicators genuinely drive performance, and how data can support better outcomes. You will help colleagues understand the story behind the data: what it means, why it matters, what is driving the result, what action it supports and how it contributes to MSIG Specialty Marine’s wider transformation. Key responsibilities Own the BI product roadmap, backlog and prioritisation process based on business value, risk, urgency and strategic alignment. Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery priorities. Oversee front-end BI and dashboard development with a focus on usability, visual clarity, self-service adoption and data storytelling. Partner with business stakeholders to define practical KPI frameworks and reporting solutions, ensuring metrics are clearly linked to business objectives, performance and decision-making. Challenge reporting requests constructively to ensure they are linked to business value, decision support, operational improvement or risk reduction. Drive standardisation across reporting suites, KPI definitions, data sources, reporting logic and performance metrics. Embed quality control, testing, validation, ownership and release discipline across BI products. Support the development and adoption of a practical data governance framework. Define and embed data ownership, stewardship, metadata, lineage, data quality and reporting controls, while facilitating and supporting domain owners and data stewards to understand and take accountability for their respective roles and responsibilities. Promote data quality as a visible business measure. Support data literacy, self-service analytics and stronger adoption of trusted insight products. Use data storytelling to help stakeholders move beyond reporting what happened to understanding why it happened, what it means and what action should be taken. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve reporting and governance processes. Help position the Data Function as a value-adding partner and centre of excellence for insight, governance and future data capability. What you will bring You will bring experience across business intelligence, data products, reporting, analytics, data governance or data management. You do not need to have spent your whole career in data governance, but you should understand the importance of data quality, ownership, stewardship, definitions, lineage, controls and adoption. You are likely to have experience owning or improving BI products, dashboards, reporting suites or management information solutions. You will be confident working with senior stakeholders and translating business priorities into practical reporting and insight solutions. Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated environment would be a strong advantage. Skills And Experience Around 5–10 years’ relevant experience across BI, analytics, reporting, data management, data governance or data product ownership. Strong understanding of BI product ownership, reporting governance and data product thinking. Strong hands-on experience with Power BI is required. Experience with Microsoft Fabric would be advantageous. Experience with Tableau, Qlik or similar BI tools would be beneficial. Strong data visualisation and data storytelling skills. Ability to turn complex information into clear business insight. Strong metric-driven thinking, with the ability to define meaningful KPIs and connect performance measures to business outcomes and decisions. Experience translating business needs into requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and delivery priorities. Knowledge of data dictionaries, catalogues, metadata, lineage, KPI definitions and reporting standards. Confidence working with financial, operational or insurance-related data. SQL, data modelling or technical data platform knowledge would be useful, but the emphasis is on front-end BI, governance, usability, business partnering and storytelling. Fluent English, both written and verbal. Dutch preferred. How you will work You will be a natural bridge between business users, technical teams and leadership. You will enjoy asking good questions, challenging assumptions and helping people understand how better data can improve decisions. We Are Looking For Someone Who Is commercially aware and metric-driven; structured, proactive and solution-oriented; confident influencing without needing formal authority; strong on ownership, accountability and delivery quality; able to simplify complex data topics for non-technical audiences; collaborative, open-minded and down-to-earth; passionate about building trust in data and bringing people along the journey. Why join MSIG Specialty Marine? This is a rare opportunity to help shape the data capability of a specialist international insurance business. You will work close to the business, close to decision-makers and close to the real operational questions that matter. You will not be hidden away producing reports in isolation. You will be helping the organisation define what good data looks like, how insight should be used, and how trusted BI products can support better business performance. At MSIG Specialty Marine, you will find a practical, entrepreneurial environment where people are encouraged to take ownership, share knowledge and develop in the direction that suits their strengths and ambitions. If you enjoy combining data, business partnering, governance, product ownership and storytelling, this role gives you the platform to make a visible and lasting impact. Apply If you are excited by the opportunity to turn data into trusted insight, strengthen BI product ownership and help an international business make better decisions, we would love to hear from you.

review_candidates.description: Banking Specialist GCG Structuring · Dubai Media City · Full-time, in-office Who we are GCG Structuring is a boutique corporate structuring and advisory firm — not a business setup company . We work with high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients, principally from the CIS, Europe and MENA regions, designing multi-jurisdiction holding structures, trusts and wealth architecture. We operate across all UAE jurisdictions — DIFC, ADGM, mainland and the free zones — alongside offshore and international jurisdictions, and we are held to a standard of precision that reflects the complexity of the clients we serve. Client banking is central to what we sell, and it is the hardest part of our business to staff. Why this role exists  We have spoken to a great many compliance professionals who understand banking in theory. What we keep not finding is someone who has actually sat on both sides of the desk — inside a bank, and then across from one, placing clients into accounts. That combination is genuinely scarce in this market, and it is precisely what this role requires. This is not an administrative seat. You will own client banking end to end, and you will be the person our account managers and our clients turn to when a file is difficult. What you will do Bank selection and placement Read a client profile and know — directly, without research — which bank will take it, and on what terms. Determine the appropriate banking route, jurisdiction and institution for each client structure. Prepare and present client files to banks, and drive applications through to account opening and after-services. Set realistic expectations with clients and colleagues on what is achievable and in what timeframe. Relationships and escalation Build and hold direct relationships with relationship managers and onboarding teams across the UAE and relevant international banks. Resolve bank queries and requests for information through to completion, on the client's behalf. Handle declines: diagnose the real reason, rework and reposition the file, and place it elsewhere. Advise clients directly and credibly on what a bank will and will not accept — and structure accordingly. Working with compliance Work alongside our compliance function on CDD and EDD, UBO analysis, and source of wealth and source of Funds. Pre-empt and mitigate risk factors in a file before it reaches the bank, rather than after. Serve as the internal point of reference for client teams on banking questions. What we are looking for Both sides of the desk. Time inside a UAE bank, and hands-on experience placing clients into accounts from the client side. Live relationships with UAE relationship managers and onboarding teams that you can use from day one. Complexity . Our clients are not standard business current accounts — multi-layer ownership, cross-border source of funds, offshore holding chains, and sometimes higher-risk jurisdictions. We will want to understand how much of that you have handled. An advisor , not an administrator. The role exists to enable good business within a sensible risk framework. Credibility in front of UHNW clients — the composure to sit in the room and be believed. Valued, not required AML or compliance certification (CAMS, ICA or equivalent). Russian or Arabic alongside English. Exposure to DIFC and ADGM, offshore jurisdictions, or private banking onboarding. Growth path Compliance and banking is intended to become a service line in its own right — a business inside the business. Whoever takes this seat is expected to help build it, resource it, and grow with it. Scope, team, and compensation are expected to move with that. Our culture Positive attitude Work ethic Solution-orientedness Extreme ownership A-player attitude What we offer Employment visa and medical insurance Performance bonus linked to successful client account openings and onboarding throughput Participation in the compliance and banking service line as it generates its own revenue, on terms to be agreed 22 working days annual paid leave; support for professional certifications Direct access to the Managing Partner, and genuine ownership of your function How to apply . Send your CV to hr@gcg-structuring.com or message us on LinkedIn. Please include your compensation expectations. We are a boutique firm, and we would rather be open about that at the start than waste anybody's time at the end.
